sourceTitle: Crockpot Refried Beans For A Crowd
sourceText:
Crockpot Refried Beans For A Crowd
By: Coleen Mielke
Published: Thursday, February 18, 2010 - 11:43pm

Ingredients




1 inch sweet onion (cut  half but not chopped)
3 cups of rinsed (and sorted) DRY pinto beans
2 teaspoons salt
1 teaspoon black pepper
3 teaspoons chili powder
6 slices of crisp bacon (crumbled)
1 teaspoon ground cumin
1/2 fresh jalapeno (seeded and chopped)
9 cups water

Preparation

1 Put everything in the crockpot and cook on high for 8 hours or till tender. Drain but reserve liquid. Put drained beans into food processor and puree, adding just enough of the reserved bean liquid to make the beans the right consistency. Keep warm in the crock pot.

About


CROCK POT REFRIED BEANS FOR A CROWD
I first posted this about a year ago, and I've been tweaking it a little since then. It makes a lot of refried beans, but I'm sure they would freeze well if vacuum packed. They taste delicious and are even better the next day. I don't buy canned refried beans anymore because these are so easy to make!
